purpose: Compare bounded tactical correctness, configuration cost and color-swapped game outcomes.

tactics.objective: force mate in at most three plies, or avoid opposing forced mate in next three plies

timing: One engine search at a time. Reference certification and result annotations are outside timed search.
pilot_exclusion: pilot-overlap-tactics-enhanced was interrupted because startup overlapped test execution. It is not an analysis input or submission dataset.
limits: Constructed low-material cases are not a representative puzzle sample.
Defense acceptance certifies only the bounded horizon.
The game-budget subsets have different start sets.
Only selected-start variability is resampled; no Elo or population-strength inference.
